#en: The flight path recorded here bends around the established lanes in the same crooked arc you saw whispered through docking records on Jemison, skipping patrol grids and threading through old war debris like someone knows exactly where the blind spots live. Cross-referenced with wreck reports and that stripped yard, the approach repeats with different ship IDs, different captains, always curving toward the same quiet patch of space that never shows on official charts.
zh: 这里记录的飞行路径以一道弯曲的弧绕过既有航道——正是你在杰米森星停靠记录里听人低语过的那道弧，它跳过巡逻网格，穿过旧战争残骸，仿佛有人对盲点所在了如指掌。与残骸报告和那座被拆空的船坞交叉比对，这条接近航线反复出现，船体 ID 不同、船长不同，却总是弯向同一片从不出现在官方星图上的安静空域。

#en: Cracked open in the quiet hum of the factory, the archive spills not words but coordinates and dates, a lattice of routes that circle the same cold scars in space.  \nCross-referenced with the first stray dataslate, the ghost echoes from that silent relay, and the falsified beacon logs from the old garrison, the pattern tightens, showing how every vanished ship has been steered toward one widening wound in the lanes where a patient engineer keeps rearranging the dead.
zh: 在工厂安静的嗡鸣中被撬开后，这份档案倾泻出的不是文字，而是坐标与日期，一座环绕太空中同样冰冷伤疤的航路格栅。\n与第一块散落数据板、来自那座沉默中继站的幽灵回声，以及旧驻军的伪造信标日志交叉比对，图案逐渐收紧，显示出每一艘消失的飞船都被引向航道上一道不断扩张的伤口——一名耐心的工程师在那里不断重新摆放逝者。

#en: Shattered telemetry from the drifting husk spills across the console, reforming into a rough lattice of traffic lanes and blind spots that should not exist, each gap stitched to a single maintenance ID tied back to this grease-stained garage on a forgotten rock.  \nFollowing that ghost pattern means leaving the comfort of official manifests and stepping into the same off-ledger shadows where an angry engineer learned to turn debris and drones into his own private toll road.
zh: 来自漂流残骸的碎裂遥测洒满控制台，重组为一座本不该存在的、由交通航道与盲点构成的粗略格栅，每一处空白都缝着同一个维护 ID，而它追溯回这块被遗忘岩石上这间沾满油污的车库。\n顺着这个幽灵图案追下去，就意味着离开官方舱单的舒适区，踏入同样的账外阴影——一名愤怒的工程师在那里学会了把残骸与无人机变成自己私人的收费公路。

#en: The wreck drifts apart in a slow halo of fragments, and beneath you a single set of coordinates blinks through the static, pulsing in time with archived dosing cycles aimed at one forgotten farmstead.  \nSomeone went to great trouble to hide that link behind scrambled traffic and half-truths. From the dark relay to the jittery clinic reports and the smuggler's doctored manifests, every trail of altered air and nervous denial has been bending toward this patch of dead fields.
zh: 残骸在一圈缓缓散开的碎片晕轮中解体，而在你下方，一组坐标在静电中闪烁，脉动的节拍与那些针对一座被遗忘农场的存档投药周期一致。\n有人费了很大功夫把这条关联藏在混乱的通讯与半真半假的说法之后。从黑暗的中继站，到神经质的诊所报告，再到走私贩被动过手脚的舱单，每一条被篡改空气与紧张否认的线索都一直弯向这片死去的田野。

#en: Buried among routine hauler routes and sanitized medical shipments, a thin thread of jumps repeats the same impossible angles, skirting known anomalies like someone tracing scars on the void.  \nCross checking those paths against earlier finds, the pattern tightens around one nameless stretch of space the same disturbance you first sniffed at a forgotten buoy, then heard whispered over drinks on that quiet farming rock, where nobody wanted to admit who recalibrated their sky.
zh: 埋在例行运货航线与经过净化处理的医疗货运之间，一缕纤细的跃迁线重复着同样的不可能角度，绕开已知异常，仿佛有人在虚空的伤疤上描画。\n把这些路径与此前的发现交叉核对，图案收紧到一片无名的空域——正是你最初在一座被遗忘浮标处嗅到、随后又在宁静农场岩石上喝酒时听人低语的同一处扰动，而那里没人愿意承认是谁重新校准了他们的天空。

#en: Decoded from the beacon's whisper, the Anchor Vector Ping doesn't name a place so much as outline a direction, a slant in grav-space all her routes lean toward.  \nCross-checking it with the backwater relay, the faulty orbital transmitter, and the misaligned traffic inside this vault ship, the pattern finally resolves: every manipulated jump has been quietly steering captains toward the same off-chart convergence, just beyond where official maps are willing to draw their lines.
zh: 从信标的低语中解码后，《锚点向量脉冲》与其说是点出某个地方，不如说是勾勒出一个方向——重力空间中所有航线都倾向的一个斜面。\n把它与穷乡中继站、故障的轨道发射机，以及这艘金库飞船内错位的交通交叉核对，图案终于解析：每一次被操纵的跃迁都在悄悄把船长们引向同一个图外汇聚点，就在官方地图愿意画下界线之处以外。

#en: Scorched plating on the drifting wreck tells a different story than the official incident code: impact signatures bend sideways, as if the ship tried to turn inside its own jump corridor and almost made it. Flight path reconstructions, half-wiped from beacon archives, show the same maneuver attempted again and again along nearby lanes, always from slightly different approach vectors, all nudging toward the same dark patch of space where traffic thins and grav readings never quite settle.
zh: 漂流残骸上被烧焦的装甲讲述着与官方事故代码不同的故事：撞击痕迹向侧面弯折，仿佛这艘船试图在自己的跃迁走廊内转向，而且几乎成功了。从信标档案中半被抹除的飞行路径重建显示，同样的机动在附近航道上被一遍遍地尝试，每次接近向量都略有不同，全都轻推向同一片黑暗空域——那里交通稀疏，重力读数始终无法稳定。

#en: In the silent racks of the abandoned post, the mixture's residue stains a single analysis bay, its readings spiking only when the receivers sweep past a narrow sliver of sky.  \nCross-referencing those fluctuations with the altered storm signatures from the frontier farm, the cut warning tapes from the forgotten relay, and the dead lab's failed experiments reveals the same thin corridor in space, a testing ground where gravity, weather, and traffic all begin to bend the way Vector wants.
zh: 在废弃哨站沉寂的架列中，混合物的残留污染了唯一一个分析舱，只有当接收器扫过天空中一条狭窄缝隙时，它的读数才会飙升。\n把那些波动与来自边境农场的被篡改风暴特征、来自被遗忘中继站被剪断的警告磁带，以及死实验室失败的实验交叉比对，便揭示出太空中同一条细薄走廊——一片试验场，那里的重力、天气与交通都开始按"向量"想要的方式弯折。

#en: When the pattern in the device finally resolves, half-forgotten coordinates from a dust-choked rock, corrupt traffic from a quiet lab, and misaligned pings from a lonely relay all snap into the same crooked flight path.  \nThat crooked line does not end here; it bends out into the dark toward a place where freighters go silent without ever filing distress, and where someone with a tug pilot's instincts has been waiting between scheduled lanes long enough to believe the system will never notice.
zh: 当装置中的图案终于清晰时，来自一块积满灰尘岩石的半被遗忘坐标、来自安静实验室的损坏交通，以及来自孤独中继站错位的脉冲，全都归入同一条弯曲的飞行路径。\n那条曲线并不止于此；它弯入黑暗，通向一个货船无声消失、从未发出求救的地方，也通向某个具备拖船飞行员直觉的人一直在计划航道之间守候、久到相信整个系统永远不会察觉之处。

#en: The readings carved into the wreck's guidance logs twist like a coiled line across the star map, linking old UC sensors, freighter routes, and a handful of marginal worlds that have all enjoyed impossible weather.  \nWhat looked like scattered interference now resolves into a single trajectory, bending every altered sky toward the same thin slice of space just beyond the official charts, tightening the hunt from dusty outposts and dead bounty ships to whatever waits along that hidden pressure path.
zh: 刻在残骸制导日志里的读数像一条盘绕的线横穿星图，把旧联殖传感器、货船航线，以及少数几颗都享受过不可能天气的边缘世界连在一起。\n看似零散的干扰如今解析成一条单一轨迹，把每一片被篡改的天空都弯向官方星图之外同一片狭薄空域，把追查从尘封的哨站和死去的赏金船收窄到那条隐秘压力路径上等待之物。

#en: The beacon's telemetry isn't just broadcasting position; buried in its soft-cycle pings is a repeating window where local sensors go blind, then a narrow grav-jump corridor aimed toward a dead patch of charted space.  \nCross-referenced with the anomalies at that abandoned homestead, the corrupted readings from the crippled satellite, and the substrate entries in the tower logs, the pattern finally resolves into a route she has been using over and over, always slipping just past official patrol lines.
zh: 信标的遥测不只广播位置；在它柔和的循环脉冲中埋着一扇反复出现的窗口——本地传感器会失明，随后是一条狭窄的重力跃迁走廊，指向已测绘太空中一片死寂区域。\n与那座废弃农场聚落的异常、来自受损卫星的损坏读数，以及塔内日志中的基质条目交叉比对，图案终于解析成一条她一再使用的路线，每次都恰好从官方巡逻线旁滑过。

#en: The relay techs say the rocks out there drift wrong, but their scopes keep logging the same faint pulse bending traffic around the field like water around a stone.  \nTied to the freight records you lifted in the moonside warehouse, that signal repeats the same skewed timing you saw in the crippled freighter's misjump and the doctored routes hidden in backwater manifests, all tracing the careful hand of one navigation analyst who has turned bad math into a weapon and is already setting his next corridor.
zh: 中继站的技术员说那边的岩石漂移得不对劲，但他们的示波器一直记录到同一道微弱脉冲，像水绕石头一样把交通弯过那片场区。\n与你从卫星侧仓库里取走的货运记录绑在一起，那道信号重复着你在受损货船错误跃迁中见过、也藏在穷乡舱单里的被动手脚航线的同样歪斜时序，全都勾勒出一名领航分析员小心翼翼的手——他把糟糕的数学变成了武器，而且已经在布置下一条走廊。

#en: The signal geometry etched into the soil should not match anything this far from a traffic hub, yet it dovetails perfectly with the irregular corridors traced in orbit.  \nComparing it against the earlier scraps from that backwater slate and the falsified cargo paths off the derelict depot, the pattern sharpens: a private chain of skewed jumps, abandoned wrecks, and delayed responses, all quietly curving toward the same stretch of darkened lanes where one unregistered tug is always a few minutes ahead of help.
zh: 刻入土壤的信号几何，本不该与离交通枢纽如此之远处的任何东西吻合，却与在轨道上追踪到的不规则走廊完美拼接。\n比照来自那块穷乡石板的更早碎片与从废弃仓库取下的伪造货运路径，图案变得锋利：一串私密的歪斜跃迁、被遗弃的残骸与迟缓的响应，全都悄然弯向同一片昏暗航道——那里总有一艘未登记的拖船，比救援早到几分钟。

#en: When the uplink's last cached transmission unspools, it carries not words but a chorus of distorted distress calls, all bent along the same narrow band of space and all cut short at nearly identical coordinates the official charts pretend are empty.  \nStacked beside the stray data from that forgotten rock and the mismatched pings recovered at the dead relay, the recording turns rumor into geometry, outlining a corridor of guided wrecks that curves toward an unnamed convergence far from any sanctioned traffic lane.
zh: 当上行链路最后缓存的传输展开时，它承载的不是文字，而是一组合唱般失真的求救呼叫，全都沿同一片狭窄空域弯折，全都在几乎相同、而官方星图假装空无一物的坐标处被戛然掐断。\n与来自那块被遗忘岩石的散落数据、以及从死中继站找回的对不上脉冲叠放在一起，这段录音把传言变成了几何，勾出一条由被引导残骸构成的走廊，弯向远离任何制式交通航道的一处无名汇聚点。

#en: A bartender wiping glasses with recycled greywater mentions taps that run clear one day, then metallic and thin the next, always after the same off-shift hauler crew rolls through.  \nAnother worker swears she saw unfamiliar techs checking valves in a closed-off corridor, while management insists nothing has changed; taken with the corrupted slate from the rock and the first whispers out of Neon, it sounds less like bad maintenance and more like someone quietly testing where they can bend a whole settlement's throat.
zh: 一名用回收灰水擦杯子的酒保提到，龙头一天流出清水，第二天就变得金属味十足、细弱无力，总是在同一批下班的运货船员经过之后。\n另一名工人发誓她看到陌生的技师在封闭走廊里检查阀门，而管理层坚称一切照旧；连同那块岩石上损坏的石板和从霓虹城传出的最早低语一起看，这听起来不像糟糕的维护，而更像有人在悄悄试探能把整座定居点的喉咙掰到什么程度。

#en: The entries scrawled across the manifest run like a spill themselves, scheduled routes warping into sudden diversions, whole shipments vanishing into the margins where no port name is printed.  \nCross-checking the times and cargo with that stray slate from the backworld rock and the half-spoken accounts from freight hands, a pattern emerges: routine hauls quietly peeled off the main lanes, always after the same delayed response, always toward the same stretch of space where records thin out and wreck reports pile up.
zh: 横贯舱单的那些潦草条目本身就像一次泼洒，排定的航线扭曲成突如其来的改道，整批货物消失在没印任何港口名的页边。\n把时间与货物同来自穷乡岩石的那块散落石板、货运工人们半吞半吐的讲述交叉核对，一个图案浮现：例行货载悄然从主航道剥离，总在同样的迟缓响应之后，总朝着同一片记录变稀、残骸报告堆叠的空域。

#en: The fragment hidden in orbit is like a mirror cracked on purpose; its equations fork in two clear directions, one pointing back toward polished corridors and oversight logs, the other out toward the loose edge of the lanes where no one files proper reports.  \nDecoded, it tells you that every falsified accident in the lab and every whispered correction from frontier captains were not random strokes of genius or madness, but parts of a single model being tested both in the heart of UC territory and far beyond its reach.
zh: 藏在轨道中的这块碎片像一面被故意打碎的镜子；它的方程朝两个清晰的方向分叉，一支指回光鲜的走廊与监管日志，另一支指向航道松散边缘——那里无人提交正式报告。\n解码后，它告诉你实验室里每一起伪造事故、边境船长们每一句低语的修正，都不是天才或疯狂的随机笔触，而是同一个模型的一部分，既在联殖领地的心脏、也在其触不可及之处被测试着。

#en: The trace pattern clinging to that lonely rock matches a faint chemical and grav signature now detected on a forgotten satellite in distant orbit, as if the same hand tested its tricks in both places.  \nTaken with the corrupted log at the first outpost and the off-kilter readings from the earlier transmitter, this residue finally links ground, sky, and drift into one continuous line, suggesting she has been walking her experiments outward step by careful step, always along corridors everyone assumed they already understood.
zh: 附着在那块孤独岩石上的痕迹图案，与如今在一颗遥远轨道中被遗忘卫星上探测到的微弱化学与重力特征吻合，仿佛同一只手在这两处试验过自己的把戏。\n连同第一座哨站里损坏的日志与更早那台发射机失常的读数一起看，这些残留终于把地面、天空与漂流连成一条连续的线，暗示她一直在小心地一步步把实验向外推进，总是沿着所有人都以为早已理解的走廊。

#en: When the canisters rupture and the last shimmer of altered space bleeds off into the dust, the Razor Strays' bravado goes with it; what they were guarding was never just hardware, but the promise of more "miracle shortcuts" to sell.  \n\nIn the wreckage their handler's slate keeps blinking, still queued to transmit calibration logs and payment records to a single repeating contact tag, the same one buried in a doctored manifest on that drifting cargo hauler and echoed in the corrupted slate from the rock where this all began.
zh: 当储罐爆裂、被篡改空间的最后一丝微光渗入尘土时，剃刀流浪帮的气焰也随之消散；他们守护的从来不只是硬件，而是兜售更多"奇迹捷径"的承诺。\n\n在残骸中，他们那位经手人的石板仍在不停闪烁，仍排队要把校准日志与付款记录发送到一个反复出现的单一联系标签——它同样埋在那艘漂流货船被动过手脚的舱单里，也回响于这场追查起始之岩石上那块损坏的石板中。

#en: When you sync the fractured signal from the node with the hangar's stripped down systems, two streams of data resolve into one map overlay, tracing outbound environmental commands from the derelict bay to a single, unlisted coordinate in deep space.  \nThe pattern matches testimonies from frightened settlers planetside and the buried UC logs you pried out of that listening post, confirming that every "upgrade" and every falsified incident has been feeding the same hidden endpoint, waiting for someone to notice the convergence.
zh: 当你把来自节点的断裂信号与机库被拆空后的系统同步时，两股数据流解析成一张地图叠加层，从废弃的船坞舱一路勾出向外的环境指令，直到深空中一个未登记的单一坐标。\n这图案与地表惊恐定居者的证词、以及你从那座监听站撬出的被掩埋联殖日志吻合，证实每一次"升级"和每一起伪造事件都在喂养同一个隐秘终点，只等着有人注意到这处汇聚。
